findings: learner.components[2]: “the cited Old Chinese form is similar to 箇’s” misrepresents its cited sound comparison. The sound card displays Baxter–Sagart *[k]ˤa-s for 固 and *kˤa[r]-s for 箇, but learner.components[2] cites X-17831a459340c809d1cd for 固, whose listed *[k]ˤa-s is attributed to Baxter–Sagart, and X-e895ad1a27cacfa3d8db for 箇. The cited packet notes that a freshly inspected same-system comparison for 固 was not retrieved. Revise the card or its citations so it does not imply this comparison is established by those cited excerpts.
